resources.string: Stops the apps you chose to protect from opening.

SafeGuard uses this service only to learn the name of the app that opened, so it can stop the apps you added to “Protected apps”. It doesn\'t read screen content or what you type, and sends no data off your device. You can turn the service off here at any time.
Checks text shown in supported apps (such as Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and Chrome) against your protection settings, on your device.

SafeGuard uses this service only in the supported apps you left on in SafeGuard (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Facebook, Chrome, Firefox). It reads the text those apps show on screen and checks it on your device against your protection settings. It never reads what you type or password fields and never stores or sends anything. If content is blocked, it swipes to the next item, or goes back or to the home screen. Images are checked only if you also allow screen capture in SafeGuard. You can turn the service off here at any time.
